verdict.rationale: Stagehand is an SDK (act/observe/extract primitives) embedded in normal TS/Python/Go code, and docs note 'you are already writing the orchestration' (stagehand-docs-26) and describe converting 'agent-discovered workflows' into deterministic scripts (stagehand-docs-29), implying loops/conditionals/parameters come from the host language rather than a built-in workflow engine. There's no explicit documentation of a dedicated workflow-composition feature (e.g., parameterized flows, branching primitives) as a first-class product capability. Missing for 10: explicit docs/examples of parameterized reusable workflows, native conditional/loop constructs, or a workflow templating system beyond raw host-language code.
